name: Letter from Nadine
summary:
A story-driven puzzle thriller third-person perspective game that is immersed in darkness and mystery. Explore an unknown reality where time is precious and monsters await. Here, action gives way to introspection. A journey through the shadows in search of a light that may no longer belong to the world of the living.

Among the folds of a world suspended between memory and oblivion, a young woman awakens in a dark place and tries to find her way out. Each step takes her deeper, through fragments of memories, whispers of forgotten voices, and monsters that do not harm the body but the soul.

Through puzzles, she’ll unlock closed paths, face creatures, create new trails of light, and uncover scattered clues. She will piece together what has been broken, read between the lines of abandoned notes, and follow the thread of a story that speaks of loss, guilt, and rebirth.
